turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Taylor Kim. Taylor Kim was charged twice for the same order last week, and I'm calling to request a refund for the duplicate.

turns.text: I'm sorry about the double charge. I've submitted a refund request for the duplicate payment. It should be processed within five to seven business days.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: How long will the refund take?

turns.text: I'd be happy to help with that. Everything is all set on our end.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Can you confirm the refund has been issued?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're welcome! Have a wonderful day. Goodbye!
